character.name: Tavi
character.starting_goal: choose and justify one reliable rescue transmission under a strict battery limit
starting_relationships: Controller Ren mentors Tavi from the station hub.
Rescue coordinator Hale accepts messages only with confidence annotations.

world.habitat: vacuum servicing corridors and an orbital telecommunications relay above Aster
world.technology_level: battery-powered emergency radios, orbital telemetry, delayed long-range transmissions
world.magic_level: none; no teleportation or verified time travel
world.summary: Aster's orbital relay network is monitored by civilian apprentice technicians. Packet timestamps can drift due to faults. Signal propagation, limited reserves and order of operations remain physically binding.
social_context: A technician can forward an independently checked distress packet.
A false distress relay diverts limited rescue resources.
Time-stamp anomalies are not proof of changes in time.
known_pressures: A distressed vessel may need help while relay power drains.
A misleading packet risks the only remaining emergency channel.
